notes.title: Bigger Update
notes.notes:
Added the pyramid character.
Made the sphere a default character and the pyramid now needs to be unlocked by beating first boss.
Decreased Cube's self damage from 40 -> 35.
Increased one of the final boss's attack's damage.

:)

notes.notes:
